title: 第3章 真苟系统第4章 小仙女
slug: 重生本统子教宿主当老六
content_zh:
“搞什么！
摸摸都不让！”
9527躺在地上吐槽道。
“9527，你又再搞什么幺蛾子？”
009的声音凭空响起，下一秒009直接出现在仓库空间里。
这次不是视频通话，而是切切实实的一个浑身科技感的银发美女。
“姐…姐姐？你怎么来了？”
第一次见到009本人，身为系统的9527竟忍不住对她的美貌着迷起来。
“少废话，你刚才是不是想偷东西？”
009怒视着9527。
“没有没有，我只是想看看。”
9527连忙辩解。
“看可以，不准动手！”
“知道啦！
姐姐，既然不让我碰，为什么要给我看啊？”
9527好奇地问道。
“给你看看有什么好东西，当然是为了更好地给宿主画饼啦！
咳咳。”
似乎是感觉自己说的有点欠妥，009连忙干咳一声：“不对不对，是为了让你更好地给宿主树立目标。”
“你刚才明明是说漏嘴了吧。”

9527小声嘀咕道。
“你说什么？竟敢调侃姐姐？”
“没有没有。
我是说姐姐真漂亮！”
“那是当然！”
009对这个马屁很受用，满脸的得意。
“姐姐，我什么时候也能有自己的形象啊？我也想变好看一点。”
每当看着自己那显示屏的身躯，9527就忍不住一阵嫌弃。
“想要个不一样的形象？”
“嗯嗯！”
“那我就勉为其难地满足你吧！”
“真的？姐姐真好，姐姐万岁！”
9527没想到009会这么轻易地答应自己，万分激动地呐喊着。
只见009一挥手，9527明显感觉到自己的身体发生了什么变化，低头一看却傻眼了，自己的手怎么好像动物的腿？回头一看，自己的身体居然变成了一条大黑狗。
看着009憋笑的样子，9527欲哭无泪地喊道：“姐姐你这是干什么？”
“这个形象多好，很符合你苟系统的气质啊！
哈哈哈哈。”
009终于忍不住哈哈大笑起来。
content_en:
"What are you doing!
Don’t let me touch you! "
9527 lay on the ground and complained.
"9527, what are you doing again?"
009's voice sounded out of thin air, and the next second 009 appeared directly in the warehouse space.
This time it was not a video call, but a real silver-haired beauty with a sense of technology.
"Sister...sister? Why are you here?"
The first time he saw 009 in person, System 9527 couldn't help but become fascinated by her beauty.
"Stop talking nonsense, did you just want to steal something?"
009 glared at 9527.
"No, no, I just want to take a look."
9527 quickly defended.
"It's okay to look at it, but don't do it!"
"I know!
Sister, since you don’t let me touch it, why do you show it to me? "
9527 asked curiously.
"I'm going to show you what good stuff I have, of course it's to better impress my host!
Ahem. "
As if he felt that what he said was a bit inappropriate, 009 quickly coughed: "No, no, it's so that you can better set goals for the host."
"You obviously let it slip just now."
9527 whispered.
"What did you say? How dare you tease my sister?"
"No, no.
I mean, my sister is so beautiful! "
"Of course!"
009 was very pleased with this flattery, and his face was full of pride.
"Sister, when can I have my own image? I also want to look better."
Whenever he looked at his body with the display screen, 9527 couldn't help but feel disgusted.
"Want a different image?"
"Yeah!"
"Then I will reluctantly satisfy you!"
"Really? My sister is so kind. Long live my sister!"
9527 didn't expect 009 to agree to him so easily, and shouted excitedly.
When 009 waved his hand, 9527 clearly felt something had changed in his body. When he looked down, he was dumbfounded. Why did his hand look like an animal's leg? Looking back, I saw that my body had turned into a big black dog.
Seeing 009 holding back his laughter, 9527 shouted without tears: "Sister, what are you doing?"
"This image is so good, it fits your Gou System temperament very well!
Hahahaha. "
009 finally couldn't help laughing.
